---

## The Core Claim

A network of interconnected binary units, updated asynchronously, provably converges to a local minimum of an energy function with the exact mathematical form of the Ising model from statistical physics -- not an analogy to it, the same energy function -- and those energy minima function as content-addressable associative memories, retrievable from partial or noisy input. John Hopfield won the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics for this, jointly with Geoffrey Hinton.
